research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ferveret is engaged in developing systems and methods for cooling heat sources, as described in 'Systems and methods for heat exchange' and 'Systems and methods for cooling.' These approaches utilize containers, liquid-liquid heat exchangers, baffles, and recirculation loops to remove heat from liquids in contact with heat sources, drawing inspiration from nuclear power plant cooling. The company’s research and development centers on advanced liquid cooling technologies for efficient thermal management.

overview_description.description:
Ferveret develops liquid cooling technology for data centers inspired by nuclear power plant cooling. We save data centers 96% in cooling costs, 68% on capital costs, and reduce their carbon footprint by 40% while increasing chip performance by 2X. Today, about 40% of the electricity used in these facilities is wasted on cooling.

Our technology eliminates this wasted energy.
